title: Changelog - March 2025
content:
## Changelog - March 2025


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000104118

New Features:

- Added functionality to search for multiple members by ID using comma-separated notation in the keyword search filter on the Search Members page in Admin. For example, searching for the keyword "#1,2,3" will return the members with IDs 1, 2, and 3.

- Added support for the Finnish language .

- Added support for 6 new languages to the Default Website Language setting: Ukrainian, Spanish (Spain), Russian, Slovenian, Slovak, and Albanian.

Enhancements / Fixes:

- Implemented bug fixes and performance enhancements to the Import Business Data tool in Admin.

- Resolved an issue preventing the Billing Cronjob from executing correctly in some scenarios.

- Enhanced compatibility between the "Chat Messages" sidebar link in Member Dashboard and the "Enable Private Chat Messages" Membership Plan Setting.

- Fixed Date Picker functionality when creating or editing posts with customized "Member Dashboard URL: Add Post" and "Member Dashboard URL: Add Multi-Photo Post" Advanced Settings.

- Made several improvements to the Change Domain Wizard tool in the Domain Manager section of Admin panel.

- Modified the Froala Email WYSIWYG editor to use rendered image dimensions (width/height attributes) instead of the original image size when uploading images to Email Templates.

- Resolved an issue affecting Digital Product purchases when using the Razorpay payment gateway.

- Enhanced the "Google Website Translator" Add-On to prevent translation of member names on public-facing pages.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the "Predictive Keyword Search" Add-On from functioning correctly in specific scenarios.

- Resolved a bug affecting selecting a country as a Service Area in the Member Dashboard.

- Fixed an issue with the Import Member Data logic during CSV member imports.

- Implemented performance optimizations and bug fixes for the Import Business Data tool in Admin.

- Fixed an issue when saving the "Default Title Text for Comments Section" and "Use Alternate Title for This Comment Section" Post Type Settings in the Admin.

- Updated the "Member Profile Analytics" Add-On to exclude Admin visits from statistics logging.

- Resolved an issue with the Brilliant Directories Zapier App that affected post trigger functionality.

- Refreshed the Admin styling for improved usability.

- Fixed a dependency issue when loading the Import Business Data page when no Default Website Language was selected.

- Resolved an issue with the "Stock Photo Library" Add-On for Cover Photo image uploads.

- Fixed a sorting issue with the 'Sort By Most Reviews' option after performing radius location searches on member search results.

- I mproved canonical URL handling to support special characters on frontend pages.

- Fixed an issue where the Manual Member Geocoding page failed to function correctly in the Admin in some cases.

- Resolved a bug preventing automatic matching between members and leads when lead location data contained apostrophes.

- Fixed an issue preventing new post comments from being saved in some cases.

- Implemented 301 redirect rule generation for "Member Write a Review", "Member Review Details", and "Member Send Message" pages when a member's profile page URL is updated.

- Fixed an issue with Member Search Results when searching by category in some cases.

- Updated the "Serves All Locations" badge on member profile pages to only appear when the "Multi-Location Listings" Add-On is active.

- Fixed an Order Summary display issue on checkout pages occurring when both the "Member Credit System" and "Easy Coupon Codes" Add-Ons were not active.

- Fixed an issue that prevented exporting the 'member_email' data from the Transaction History page in the Admin.

- Updated the website logo width validation on the frontend of sites.

- Fixed an issue that was affecting the ability to search members when using the "Find Duplicates" filter on the Search Members page in the Admin.

- Released a security update to the Community Comments Add-On.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the "Type of Offer:" from displaying properly on Coupon details pages.

- Fixed an issue that was preventing the Google reCAPTCHA form field from displaying correctly when used multiple times on the same page.

- Fixed an issue that was preventing members from adding Nebraska, USA as a Service area From the Member Dashboard in some cases.

- Fixed an issue that was preventing users from importing 301 Redirects on the Admin in some cases.

- Updated the Google Maps integration for compatibility with the new version of the Places API.

- In all, over 60 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month.
